Doctor: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today? Patient: For about three weeks I’ve had a small, round swelling in my neck that started painless but has been gradually getting bigger. I’m also feeling sweaty palms and soles, insomnia, irritability, nervousness, and fatigue.
[ASK] Do you have new or worsening shortness of breath with wheezing or chronic cough (breathing difficulty)?
Patient: No, I haven’t had any shortness of breath, wheezing, or chronic cough.
[ASK] Have you had episodes of fainting or near-fainting (syncope) recently?
“No, I haven’t had any fainting or near-fainting episodes.”
[ASK] Do you have psychiatric symptoms such as hallucinations/delusions or prominent mood/psychosis symptoms consistent with schizoaffective disorder or schizophrenia-spectrum personality disorders?
“No, I haven’t had hallucinations, delusions, or any concerning mood or psychosis symptoms like that.”
[ASK] Have you noticed a new, persistent tremor or stiffness that is mainly on one side and has been gradually worsening over time?
Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any new persistent tremor or stiffness, and nothing seems to be mainly on one side.
[ASK] Have you had a sudden, stress-related episode of chest pain or shortness of breath with a transient “broken-heart” pattern on heart imaging (Takotsubo cardiomyopathy–like presentation)?
“No, I haven’t had any sudden, stress-related chest pain or shortness of breath, and I’ve not been told about any broken-heart pattern on heart imaging.”
[ASK] Have you noticed a new, painless loss of vision or weakness on one side of the body (suggesting a neurologic deficit)?
“No, I haven’t had any painless loss of vision, weakness, or anything like numbness on one side of my body.”
[ASK] Have you had episodes of swelling (especially around the eyes/legs) or foamy urine consistent with nephrotic syndrome?
“No, I haven’t noticed any swelling around my eyes or legs, and I haven’t seen foamy urine.”
[ASK] Have you had a recent episode of viral illness (especially with rash) or known exposure to rubella during pregnancy or early life?
“No, I haven’t had a recent viral illness with rash, and I don’t know of any rubella exposure during pregnancy or early life.”
